title: SB2801 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, prohibits the sale of firearms to persons who are listed on the federal terrorist watchlist. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1316.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2020-02-06; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513212410 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/111/Bill/SB2801.pdf (LegiScan doc 2126090))
provenance.note: Draft (as filed), 2020-02-06; document names HB 2424 (Beck) and SB 2801 (Akbari). Adopted amendments, if any, are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(a)(1)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1316(a)(1), is amended by inserting the language "who are listed on the federal terrorist watchlist," immediately after the language "who are ineligible to receive firearms under 18 U.S.C. § 922,".
